lane: Maps, lighting and post (max env), fix round

items.evidence: ENV-1_jungle_fix_ab.png plus my recapture _harness/_shots/maxenv/verify2/rift_jungle_w.png (High, t=20) against fix_before: the wood is visibly thinned, upper plates catch the sun, and dial-tick ferns now fill gaps and wall feet. jungle_w and jungle_s read as layered; jungle_e barely changes. Residual: the canopy is still one fan-plate species, and the cleared floor in jungle_w reads as dark empty moss.

ENV-4_outflow_fix_ab.png and recapture verify2/rift_outflow.png (1:1 crop checked): the hard bright bottom edge is gone, and the mouth feathers onto the road with soft falling streaks. Residual: a lit vertical strip still marks the channel's left edge, and the streak curtain is faint, so at game zoom it reads as a soft shimmer, not a spill.

ENV-3_hour_stone_fix_ab.png and recapture verify2/fray_stones.png: the two dial blocks separate clearly, with a gap and a step, and the lid-seam coffin cue is gone. They still read as dark blocks at L* ~22 (by design), but they now read as two stones, not one casket.

ENV-6_rubble_fix_ab.png and recapture _harness/_shots/verify2_struct_ruin.png: the chunks are chipped, and none is near black. Three are still a cool dark grey and nearly flat-looking against the warm paving, so the gain is modest.
ENV-7_slab_cap_fix_ab.png: one ridge row of chevron hour ticks with longer quarters replaces the vent-slot rows, and it now reads as a dial band.
Recapture verify2/rift_core.png against verify1/rift_core.png: the core, turrets and gate are still opaque stone with a rim and plinth ticks; no regression from the final structures.ts.

problems.what: The RIFT canopy is still a single Dialwood fan species. The plan's second and third crown families (a tall narrow crown, more silhouette variety) never landed.
problems.fix: Next env wave: a second canopy silhouette that replaces some Dialwood instances (triangle-neutral), plus floor value break-up in the thinned clearings.

problems.what: The outflow channel keeps a lit vertical left edge, and the fall reads faint at game zoom
problems.fix: Feather the channel side edges the way the mouth is feathered, and raise the crest foam contrast a little.

problems.what: Outside this lane (VFX): the ink_puff layer in lib_structure_break and lib_structure_land draws near-black blobs with pale rims over the falling tower and the landing, so they read as holes punched in the frame
problems.evidence: _harness/_shots/verify2_struct_collapse_240.png and maxenv_struct_fix_collapse_140/177.png (absent from the 16:48 before frames)
problems.fix: VFX lane: lighten the ink_puff colour toward the dust value, or shrink and shorten it, for structure collapses.

notes: I read all five fix A/B sheets and recaptured jungle_w/e/s, outflow, core, gate, FRAY stones and centre, plus the RIFT collapse and ruin, on the current source. I found nothing broken and no blocker. Sensitivity: none. Originality: the tick fern (dial-tick pinnae), the hour-stones and the slab cap are VALE's own and have no LoL counterpart. The lane is clearly better than verify1 (both majors addressed), but the jungle still reads as one species, so the score stays just under the 7.5 par.
